evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The proliferation of Large Language Models has catalyzed powerful application development platforms like Dify, which enable users to build sophisticated LLM-powered workflows through modular node orchestration.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate \textsc{ChatDify} on a curated benchmark of 100 production-inspired tasks across three state-of-the-art LLM backends, achieving 0.96, 0.91, and 0.75 success rates with Qwen-3.7, GLM-5.1, and DeepSeek-v4, respectively.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
